abort.discovery_only: HA Windows Bridge is discovered automatically after the Windows application connects to MQTT.
abort.invalid_discovery: The MQTT discovery message is invalid.
abort.no_entities: No entities are enabled in the Windows application.

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Do you want to add **{name}**? All enabled controls, switches, sensors and the Media Player will appear in one HA Windows Bridge integration.

show_overlay.name: Show Windows overlay
show_overlay.description: Shows a validated, passive message on the selected Windows computer.

notification_id.name: Message ID
notification_id.description: Stable ID used to update or remove this message later.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Up to eight characters, for example an emoji.

image.name: Embedded image
image.description: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP data URI up to 512 KiB.

layout.name: Layout
layout.description: Media places a supplied image next to the title and message.

update_overlay.name: Update Windows overlay
update_overlay.description: Replaces an existing overlay message with the same ID.

remove_overlay.name: Remove Windows overlay
remove_overlay.description: Removes the current or queued overlay message with this ID.

clear_overlay.name: Clear Windows overlays
clear_overlay.description: Hides the current overlay and clears its queue.
